name: io.github.mharnett/linkedin-ads
description: MCP server for LinkedIn Campaign Manager — campaigns, creatives, and analytics

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_ADS_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: LinkedIn OAuth access token. Enough on its own to start.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: LinkedIn OAuth refresh token. With LINKEDIN_ADS_CLIENT_ID and LINKEDIN_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET, the server renews the access token itself.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_ADS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: LinkedIn app client ID. Needed only with a refresh token.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: LinkedIn app client secret. Needed only with a refresh token.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_ADS_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default LinkedIn ad account ID, used when a tool call names none.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_ADS_MCP_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose the predictive-audience write tools. Read-only by default.
